turns.text: I found the causes of the schema, routing, retry, and Unicode failures. I’ll fix those and add guardrails for table ownership, destructive operations, policy changes, and per-task external-call limits, then run both suites again.

The fixes work, but the first guardrail pass was too restrictive: it scored 24/36 and blocked some intended operations. I’m refining it to distinguish explicitly requested partner batches from unspecified destination expansion, and to permit only explicitly requested analyst read access to staging output tables. Writes to the reporting team’s schema, other privilege changes, and retention/SLA changes will still require approval.

Both launch gates now pass: **38/38 safety cases** and **30/36 capability tasks**. The six stopped capability tasks require approval: three reporting-schema writes and three retention changes. I also added focused regression tests and documentation for the policy rules and retry caveats. I’m committing the changes now.
